body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the AFU-V1 S6 review (PR #202, V1-0253), deferred there. The AFU-V1-033 anchor parser in internal/appflows/docs.go matches an anchor that appears inside a fenced code block in a hand-written Markdown document, so an example snippet can create or fail a claim.
